scope: Tag prices and extension quotes were both computed off the wrong base. The 10% tag floor now uses the contract-deadline AAV snapshot only (canon C8-A) instead of max(deadline, current) — the version that still priced Malik Willis at $41K off a $2K snapshot when his $16K tier price governs. Extension previews now escalate off the contract's AAV rather than the loaded current-year salary, the PR #780 fix that shipped in the shared module and trade workbench but never reached this duplicate: Drake London quoted $62K instead of $43K.
